name: ingest
summary: What a bank actually exports, turned into the shapes everything else runs on. Four things that look like parsing and are not: the SIGN (Discover writes a purchase positive, Bank of America writes it negative), the DATE (03/04 is two dates and an all-under-13 file is genuinely ambiguous), the AMOUNT (a float multiply loses a cent before anything can check itself), and the COMMAS. Every packaged profile is UNVERIFIED and says so.
